description: This Kotlin source file defines an adapter for Android's RecyclerView to display focusable content cards with images and titles, optimized for TV interfaces using centerCrop images and DP-based sizing for focus effects.

classes.name: ContentCardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for focusable content cards, handling item diffing, view creation, and binding.

classes.name: ContentCardAdapter.CardVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual card views, including focus animations and data binding.

classes.name: DiffUtil.ItemCallback<ContentItem>
classes.description: Implementation to optimize list updates by checking item identities and content equality.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout and creates a new ViewHolder for each item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolder at a specified position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Populates ViewHolder views with ContentItem data, loading images with Glide and setting accessibility content description.
